name: Takanashi Hazumu
source:
A slave enrolled at the SM club "Combat de Reines". In front of the patrons she's the perfect lolita slave, but she's actually quite fierce and has a potty mouth. She has the obstinate personality of an old man.

[translated from [url=http://www.scarecrow.co.jp/abp/mxs/txt_char.htm]official site[/url]]
